question: In which of the following cities was the 89th Annual General Meeting of the Board of Control for Cricket in India held?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ahmedabad**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** BCCI held its 89th Annual General Meeting **on **24th December 2020 at Ahmedabad**.
 
• **Board of Control for Cricket in India( BCCI)**__
 
 
• It is the governing body for cricket in India and is under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports, Government of India.
 
• Headquarters: Mumbai
 
• President: Sourav Ganguly **(As of March 2022).**
 
• Vice-President: Rajeev Shukla (As of March 2022).
 
• Secretary: Jay Shah (As of March 2022).
 
• Men's Cricket Team Coach: Rahul Dravid (As of March 2022).
 
• Women's Cricket Team Coach: Ramesh Powar (As of March 2022).
